name: Trash Party
summary: Trash Party is an online co-op party game for up to four players. You and your friends are the garbage collectors of a colorful cartoon city: one player drives the truck while the others grab bags, throw them in and hang off the back to catch a ride. Sort trash into recycling, organic and glass compartments to earn points and extra time, run bulky items like sofas and fridges through the compactor, and clean the whole city to earn stars that unlock new levels on a world map hub. It can also be played solo.
